description: The featured-collection rotation: which collection is featured in which ISO week. Hand-editable and append-only — published weeks have already been shipped in a release, so change them only to fix a mistake. scripts/suggest_featured.py proposes new weeks (never-featured first, category spacing, seasonal hints) and scripts/build_featured.py turns this file into the published featured-collections.json.
